title: センター！センター！センター！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Smart Falcon wins her first race and fulfills her ambition to take center stage in a winning concert.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now that she's experienced the joy of standing center stage…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her desire to become a top Umadol grows even stronger.
